headline: Carbon TerraVault submits ~57 Mt CO2 storage application to EPA and signs Bloom Energy CCS MOU
summary: California Resources' Carbon TerraVault submitted a new Class VI application to the US EPA for a reservoir with roughly 57 million tonnes of CO2 storage capacity, and signed a non-binding MOU with Bloom Energy to evaluate up to 1 GW of solid-oxide fuel-cell power paired with CCS; its first CCS project (Elk Hills 26R) began injecting in May 2026.
co2crc_note: US Class VI storage-permitting progress and a fuel-cell+CCS pairing are reference points for Australian storage characterisation and power-plus-capture concepts.
extractor_note: 57 Mt is a cumulative storage-resource figure in a permit application, not an annual (Mtpa) rate; capacity_mtpa left null. Bloom MOU is non-binding.

headline: SNP urges UK to redirect ~£5bn of North Sea oil revenue to the Acorn CCS project
summary: The Scottish National Party called on the UK government to channel around £5bn of North Sea oil-and-gas revenue into the stalled Acorn CCS cluster in north-east Scotland, escalating the political fight over Acorn's funding after the 28 October Autumn Budget reprioritised its £200m capital grant.
co2crc_note: Illustrates the volatility of UK public funding for CCS post-Budget — a cautionary signal for policy-dependent storage clusters everywhere, Australia included.
extractor_note: The ~£5bn is a political demand (SNP call), not committed or allocated money; commitment_status set to announced.

headline: Röchling Industrial to use Celanese carbon-capture-based POM in sustainable stock shapes
summary: Röchling Industrial and Celanese partnered to launch sustainable semi-finished stock shapes made from POM (acetal) derived from captured CO2, drawing on Celanese's carbon-capture-and-utilisation methanol-to-POM chain at its Clear Lake and Bishop, Texas operations.
co2crc_note: A CO2-utilisation (CCU) product partnership with limited direct relevance to CO2CRC's geological-storage focus.
extractor_note: CCU (utilisation) rather than geological storage; date from Google-Alerts sampler, not confirmed by direct fetch (WebFetch blocked this session).
